steps: Mangkuk dan pemukul meringue kena bersih dan kering, putih telur jangan bercampur kuning langsung.
Pukul meringue sampai berkilat dan hujungnya melentur sikit, lepas tu terus berhenti.
Kaup balik perlahan guna spatula sampai tak ada jalur putih, jangan kacau kuat.
Kastard masak sampai pekat dan meletup kecil, sejukkan betul-betul sebelum campur whipping cream.
Whipping cream kena sejuk, pukul sampai puncak tegak. Kek pun kena sejuk sepenuhnya sebelum isi krim.
The meringue bowl and whisk must be clean and dry, with no yolk at all in the whites.
Whip the meringue until glossy and the tip bends slightly, then stop.
Fold gently with a spatula until no white streaks remain. Do not stir hard.
Cook the custard until thick and bubbling, then chill it fully before mixing with the whipping cream.
The whipping cream must be cold and whipped to stiff peaks. Cool the cakes completely before filling.
